purpose: supplementary repeated measurement of the preregistered allocation-search wall-time metric after the primary fresh runs; no threshold or model selection changes
decision: The strict <=1.25x per-fresh-world runtime clause misses in world 30712. Storage, allocation count, quality and retention outcomes were unchanged.
